title: Verify a symbolic two-torsion section of an elliptic Jacobian

source.citation: Valery Asiryan, Genus-One Fibrations and the Jacobian of Linear Slices in the Quintic Equal-Sum Problem, arXiv:2512.11072

translation.notes: The binary-quartic invariants are formed in `Q[S]`, and direct substitution verifies the paper’s displayed root of the Jacobian cubic. This proves the scoped polynomial identity; it does not substitute for the paper’s complete torsion argument.
